claims.text: Many reviewers say these hair ties hold long, thick hair securely without pulling or leaving creases or dents.
Several reviewers praise the durability and value, noting they hold up well and come in large quantities for the price.
A common complaint is that the ties stretch out of shape over time and do not return to their original size, even after hot water.
Some reviewers find the material hard and not very stretchy, with one reporting hair pulling.
Reviewers frequently mention the fun, cute colors and designs.
